verdict.rationale: Warp documents a broad REST API covering HR, payroll, time off, workplace and department data. It includes write endpoints (benefit deductions, custom worker fields, candidate offers) plus TypeScript/Go SDKs, a CLI and webhooks, so much of the product is programmable. However, nothing in the evidence claims parity with the UI, and the advanced API module is gated to Enterprise. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim or a coverage map, evidence of API coverage for payroll runs, tax filings, contractor payments, scheduling and provisioning, full API access on base plans, and independent hands-on corroboration.
